stops.name: Diemtigtal
stops.quote: The Diemtigtal, winner of the 1986 Wakker Award, is an idyllic, 16-km long side valley of the Simmental Valley, which is noted for its natural beauty.
stops.english: The Diemtigtal, winner of the 1986 Wakker Award, is an idyllic, 16-km long side valley of the Simmental Valley, which is noted for its natural beauty.

stops.name: Diemtigtaler Talwanderweg
stops.quote: There are many valley walks, but Diemtigtal from Oey to Schwenden is unique and deserves the highest award.
stops.english: There are many valley walks, but Diemtigtal from Oey to Schwenden is unique and deserves the highest award.

stops.name: The Diemtigtal valley historical & cultural trail
stops.quote: The historical and cultural trail showcases a selection of lifestyles and epochs in the Diemtigtal valley.
stops.english: The historical and cultural trail showcases a selection of lifestyles and epochs in the Diemtigtal valley.

stops.name: Diemtigtal Star Trail
stops.quote: The Diemtigtal Star Trail is opened with mulled wine and punch.
stops.english: The Diemtigtal Star Trail is opened with mulled wine and punch.

stops.name: Schwenden-Grimmialp
stops.quote: Schwenden-Grimmialp in Diemtigtal: hiking, skiing and relaxing in the Bernese Oberland - with alps, circular trails and typical chalet village character.
stops.english: Schwenden-Grimmialp in Diemtigtal: hiking, skiing and relaxing in the Bernese Oberland - with alps, circular trails and typical chalet village character.

stops.name: Gwunderwasser Playground
stops.quote: The Gwunderwasser Playground in the Diemtigtal Valley (Tiermatti, Schwenden) guarantees exciting experiences for young and old on the water.
stops.english: The Gwunderwasser Playground in the Diemtigtal Valley (Tiermatti, Schwenden) guarantees exciting experiences for young and old on the water.

stops.name: Bergweg Kraftort Grimmiwasser
stops.quote: Round trip hike in the picturesque region of the Diemtigtal.
stops.english: Round trip hike in the picturesque region of the Diemtigtal.
